Name: Somni's Ridgeside Village Recolor - Bog Style
Author: somnifey
Description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/FETyULb.png[/img]

Somni’s Ridgeside Village – Bog Recolor is a visual-only recolor of Ridgeside Village. All changes are purely aesthetic. No gameplay alterations are included.

Roadmap (planned updates)
• Foliage (UPDATED: 6/5/26)
• Fences
• Town Square
• Cable Car area (UPDATED: 6/5/26)
• Extra Buildings
• Animals & Bonfire visuals
• Interiors
• Spirit Realm visuals
